commits.subject: crypt: new mormot.crypt.factory unit extracted from mormot.crypt.secure
commits.body:
Implements #737 with its option B. The "Rnd/Hash/Sign/Cipher/Asym/Cert/Store
High-Level Algorithms Factories" section of mormot.crypt.secure.pas becomes
mormot.crypt.factory.pas, together with the key/certificate-aware helpers of
the PEM/DER section (CKA_OID, PrivateKeyToPkcs8, Get/SetSignatureSecurity*,
OidToCka/CkaToSeq/EccPrivKeyToSeq/SeqToEcc*/X509PubKeyToDer, TX509Parsed,
ParsedToText, the X509Parse hook and the Windows WinX509Parse parser), in a
second "Key and Certificate Aware PEM/DER Helpers" section of the new unit.

Pure move, no behavior change: every moved line is unchanged; only the uses
clauses, six fully qualified mormot.crypt.secure.Xxx() calls, the Lazarus
package and test project lists and the docs are touched. The pure PEM/DER/ASN.1
encoders and decoders stay in mormot.crypt.secure, as does the
CryptRemoteResource hook set by mormot.net.client. mormot.lib.sspi leaves the
uses clause of mormot.crypt.secure since WinCertDecode() was its only use.
commits.author: zen010101
